Q5984.reason: Anaerobic respiration is cellular metabolism without oxygen, not a respiratory-pattern abnormality; Cheyne-Stokes, central neurogenic hyperventilation, and ataxic (Biot) breathing are the classic patterns in head injury and reduced consciousness.

Q5988.reason: The defendant’s out-of-court speed statement is an opposing-party admission, so it is non-hearsay and admissible substantively against him; the best-evidence rule does not cover oral statements, and an unsworn prior inconsistent statement is not admissible for any purpose merely as impeachment.

Q5991.reason: Gerstein and County of Riverside require a prompt judicial probable-cause determination after a warrantless arrest, generally within 48 hours, so a 14-day detention without one is unconstitutional.
